stem: Which title is best for the complete passage that includes “During repairs at an old train station, workers found a wall painting hidden behind layers of paint.”?

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「The Old Wall Painting: During repairs at an old train station, workers found a wall painting hidden behind layers of paint.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「The Old Playground」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The Old Harbor」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The Old Train Line」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「The Old Wall Painting: During repairs at an old train station, workers found a wall painting hidden behind layers of paint.」，答案為「The Old Wall Painting」。
